about_the_game:
BIG NEWS: We have officially rebranded!

To better reflect the mystery and ancient adventure at the heart of our story, Wacambria Island has evolved into Secrets of Temple Isle. We are currently updating our scrolls and maps (and our store page) to reflect this epic new chapter!

Unearth the past. Lead the rebellion. Become the legend.

Secrets of Temple Isle is a story driven action RPG set on a vast, mysterious island where ancient history and war collide. Step into the boots of a daring adventurer whose quest for legendary treasure lands them at the heart of a brutal conflict between peaceful islanders and a ruthless invading army.

With the island falling under enemy control, you are the spark that will ignite a revolution. Explore sun-drenched shores, deep cavernous vaults, and crumbling temples to unlock an ancient power that could change the fate of the world. In Secrets of Temple Isle, you aren't just looking for gold—you’re fighting for freedom.

Explore a Lost World of Mystery

Venture across a sprawling landscape packed with diverse biomes, from dense jungles to arid ruins. Secrets of Temple Isle is designed for the curious: discover hidden temples, navigate treacherous caves, and scour ancient towns for loot. Enjoy High-Agency Exploration. Every corner of the island holds temple isle secrets, forgotten lore, and the trail of a legendary hero waiting to be followed.

Master Satisfying, Tactical Combat

The path to treasure is paved with danger. Engage in fluid, third-person combat where enemies aren't just targets—they’re combatants. Invading soldiers will strafe, and engage in Tactical Parry-Based Combat. Utilize an arsenal of unique weapons to overcome the odds and liberate the oppressed.

Uncover Ancient Power & Gear

Unleash your inner hero with a deep customization system. Discover and collect rare armors and cosmetic pieces throughout your journey to define your adventurer's signature look. As you solve the island’s greatest mysteries, you will tap into a long-dormant ancient power that turns the tide of battle in your favor.

Create Your Sanctuary

Even a legendary treasure hunter needs a place to rest. Purchase homes across the island and transform them into your personal headquarters. Decorate your sanctuary using a variety of materials—from rare artifacts found in ruins to exotic wares bought from local shopkeepers.
